summary_en: This summer, Europe, Asia, and North America experienced record heat, drought, wildfires, and torrential floods. Western Europe had its hottest June and July; wildfires in France forced 220,000 evacuations, and low water levels on the Rhine and other waterways affected shipping and energy supplies.

title: 为亚洲篮球注入活力（竞技观察）
title_en: Injecting vitality into Asian basketball (Sports Observation)
summary: 2026亚洲大学生篮球联赛8月11日在杭州结束，上海交通大学队以72∶69险胜台湾政治大学队夺冠，球员陈天灿获最佳球员。本届赛事国际化进程加速，中国高校球队由7支调整至5支，新增澳大利亚、菲律宾、日本、韩国、蒙古国等6支球队，不同风格球队同
summary_en: The 2026 Asian University Basketball League concluded on August 11 in Hangzhou, with Shanghai Jiao Tong University defeating Taiwan's Chengchi University 72-69 to win the championship; player Chen Tiancan was named MVP. The tournament's internationalization accelerated: Chinese university teams were reduced from 7 to 5, and six new teams from Australia, the Philippines, Japan, South Korea, and Mongolia were added, allowing teams of different styles to compete.

title: 我国与10个APEC经济体实现AEO互认
title_en: China achieves AEO mutual recognition with 10 APEC economies
summary: 记者从亚太经合组织（APEC）“经认证的经营者”（AEO）专题研讨会获悉，除巴布亚新几内亚外，APEC经济体均已建立并实施AEO制度，中国海关已与其中10个经济体实现互认。据中国海关统计，今年1—7月，我国AEO企业进出口额16.76万亿元
summary_en: The reporter learned from the APEC 'Authorized Economic Operator' (AEO) thematic seminar that except Papua New Guinea, all APEC economies have established and implemented AEO systems, and China Customs has achieved mutual recognition with 10 of them. According to China Customs statistics, in the first seven months of this year, China's AEO enterprises' import and export value reached 16.76 trillion yuan.

title: “助力孟加拉国电力结构优化和经济发展”
title_en: Helping Bangladesh optimize its power mix and economic development
summary: 近年来，中国企业在孟加拉国投资建设多个清洁能源项目。科克斯巴扎尔风电项目是孟首个集中式风电项目，2023年10月投产，满足10万户家庭用电，并培养首批风电实操人才，计划打造风光储综合智慧能源基地。迈门辛光伏项目2020年投运，使用约17万块
summary_en: In recent years, Chinese enterprises have invested in and built several clean energy projects in Bangladesh. The Cox's Bazar wind power project is Bangladesh's first centralized wind power project, put into operation in October 2023. It supplies electricity to 100,000 households and has trained the country's first group of wind power operation personnel, with plans to build an integrated smart energy base combining wind, solar and storage. The Mymensingh photovoltaic project began operation in 2020, using about 170,000 solar panels.

title: 中国队包揽冠亚军
title_en: Chinese team sweeps gold and silver
summary: 据人民日报北京8月17日电，由国际连珠联盟主办的2026年世界五子棋团体锦标赛在亚美尼亚首都埃里温闭幕，中国队包揽冠亚军。本届赛事共有来自中国、亚美尼亚、日本、波兰、俄罗斯、捷克、爱沙尼亚等7个国家的9支队伍、45名棋手参赛。比赛采用9轮单
summary_en: According to a People's Daily report from Beijing on Aug 17, the 2026 World Team Gomoku Championship hosted by the International Renju Federation concluded in Yerevan, Armenia, with Chinese teams sweeping the champion and runner-up titles. A total of 9 teams and 45 players from 7 countries, including China, Armenia, Japan, Poland, Russia, Czech Republic and Estonia, participated. The competition used a 9-round single round-robin format.
